name: metallic
title: Metallic UI
description: A metal skin for shadcn: brushed steel and eleven other alloys, with dials for polish, finish, grain, depth, density, corners, motion and sweep. Turn it on with data-material="metallic" and mount MetallicRuntime once. Civilian Studios — Metallic kit.
docs: Add data-material="metallic" (and any dials) to your <html> tag, then render <MetallicRuntime /> once in your root layout. Pick your dials at https://civilian.studio/metallic/ui
